    AI Overview
    Double Black is a stylish, pet-friendly cafe located in Mid-Levels (Mosque Street), Hong Kong, offering premium coffee, western-style all-day breakfasts, and pasta. Known for its cozy atmosphere and, as of 2026, a highly acclaimed French toast, it is a popular spot for relaxing near the Central-Mid-Levels escalator. 
    Key Details 
    • Location: Shop A, G/F, Kin Hing House, 26 Mosque Street, Mid-Levels.
    • Vibe: Modern wooden interior (formerly grey/concrete), quiet "cozy corner" in Mid-Levels, pets welcome.
    • Signature Items: French toast (often described as "insanely good"),Beef Cheek Tomato Spaghetti, Smash Burger, and strong coffee.
    • Hours: Mon–Fri: 8:30am–5:30pm; Sat/Sun/PH: 9am–6pm. 
    Recommendations 
    • Best for: A quiet brunch, coffee break, or taking a pet.
    • Tip: It can get crowded on weekends.
